data.title: 02 · 海风里的彩色糖果
data.description: 正午的旧码头边，02穿红白泳装和宽松白罩衫坐着，双腿垂向水面。一手拿着彩色糖果，另一手撑住木板，脚尖轻踢起水花；海风吹乱粉发，她回头朝镜头露出得意的鬼脸。
data.action: 旧码头边踢水花吃彩色糖果，迎风乱发后对镜头做得意鬼脸
data.lighting: crisp noon light with turquoise reflections
data.camera: full body, seated figure and feet at water visible
data.mood: 把夏日当成私人舞台的活力少女
data.promptProse: Zero Two sits on the old pier with one hand braced on the boards and the other holding her colorful sweets, her bare feet kicking a small splash below. She turns toward the viewer with a proud grin in the crisp turquoise noon light.
data.animaCaption: One hand braces on the pier; the other holds sweets while her feet kick a small splash.
